newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-JUDGE AWARDS LEWIS-MCCALL BOUT TO MAIN EVENTS.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-JUDGE AWARDS LEWIS-MCCALL BOUT TO MAIN EVENTS.

text.p: A judge awarded to Main Events the rights to promote the World Boxing Council heavyweight championship bout between Briton Lennox Lewis and Oliver McCall, ruling that Don King defaulted on his purse bid, Main Events said in a statement on Thursday.
In Passaic, New Jersey, Superior Court Judge Amos Saunders upheld the bid of $6,151,000 made by Main Events, the promotional company of the New Jersey-based Duva family.

The judge also ruled that King must forfeit his deposit and cover all legal costs accrued by Lewis, Main Events and Lewis's co-promoter Panos Eliades, and ordered that the fight take place within 90 days, the Main Events statement said.
King's lawyer could not immediately be reached. A King spokesman had no comment.
